title: Build the zero-cost preflight and the compatibility record
statement: Check configuration, auth availability, model resolution, package loading and tool signatures at no cost; store canary success keyed to its exact inputs in the local-state root; and implement every invalidation input so a changed key reopens approval.
notes: ⚠️ LAUNCH CONSUMES THIS KEY (TSK-0037, B1). The expected compatibility key must be computable at every launch from the current runtime inputs, independently of the stored record, and passed to checkLaunch as expectedKey. A different-model one-run override must have a route to obtain matching compatibility proof for that model, so the override TSK-0037 offers as a remedy can start a run.
